events.title: Making of The Flatwoods Monster
events.summary: Flatwoods Monster! She's one of the more often recognized cryptids by players, but her name seems to be the least remembered. Definitely no one else in this game as gotten the "oh, it's that one! the uh... what's it called?" reaction from players as much as her. events.title: Making of The Loveland Frogman
events.summary: It's big frog time. Loveland Frogman is probably one of the least recognized cryptids in my game. It's not uncommon for people to mistake him for a Kappa, so I'm extra glad I didn't go with the design where his eyes were more on the side of his head and less on top.The frogman is another design that I added spots to even though it's not how he's commonly depicted. events.title: Making of The Loch Ness Monster
events.summary: This time we're getting into a fan favorite, Nessie! She's probably been the most consistently recognized cryptid in the demo. That might not have been the case if I'd gone with the more mollusc-y version I considered in my first sketch though.The spots I ended up adding are kind of an unconventional choice for a Loch Ness Monster design, but I think they add charm and make her feel a little friendlier. events.title: Release Date Announcement!
events.summary: Thank you everyone for your patience! I'm excited to finally announce CryptidCam's official release date. The game will be coming out on Thursday, October 29th, just in time for Halloween. The release date should also now be publicly displayed in the store page.I hope you're looking forward to trying the full version!

events.title: Making of Tsuchinoko
events.summary: Tsuchinoko is the second cryptid I added to CryptidCam. His design is pretty simple, so it didn't take a lot of sketch iteration to feel like I had it. events.title: A Closer Look at Ted's Bookshelf
events.summary: Happy Valentine's Day! I thought it'd be fun if today we put Dr. Ted Krupp on blast a little bit for his tastes and preferences, so let's take a closer look at the bookshelf in his cabin. All of these titles are based on either real books or fictional books from other media.On the top shelf here we have mostly books that are just for fun flavor. events.title: Early CryptidCam Sketches
events.summary: These are some of the earliest cryptid sketches I have for CryptidCam, back when I was first toying around with the idea of making a game by myself.
